ui_bugs.issue: LeftNav NEVER renders for /comunidad routes on desktop. Root cause in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 148/155: <Route index element={<ComunidadPage embedded />} /> passes embedded=true, and ComunidadPage.jsx line 861 says `{!embedded && <LeftNav />}`. Therefore NONE of the requested testids (comunidad-nav-feed, comunidad-nav-explorar, comunidad-nav-ranking, comunidad-nav-wall) appear on desktop (1440x900). Since the new slim TabBar is hidden on lg+ via lg:hidden, desktop users have NO sub-section navigation at all in /comunidad — this is worse than before the refactor.

X close button [data-testid='milestone-banner-close'] fails Playwright actionability check because the sibling
🎉
intercepts pointer events. Playwright error: 'animate-bounce subtree intercepts pointer events'. Standard click times out; force=True bypasses but does NOT fire the React onClick handler. Real users can still click (visually the X is clear in top-right), and the 5.5s auto-dismiss is a safety net, but UX is brittle. Fix: add `pointer-events-none` to the inner
content wrapper at MilestoneConfetti.jsx line 148 (everything inside is presentational; the close button is a sibling), OR move the close button to be the last child with `z-10`.

critical_code_review_comments: Routing bug masks the LeftNav intent: App.js passes embedded=true so the painstakingly updated LeftNav (4 items at /comunidad lines 708-712) never reaches the DOM. The original Section 62 PR removed Chambas/Search from LeftNav but missed the gating prop. Net effect: desktop /comunidad has no in-section nav.

MilestoneConfetti is otherwise solid — single useEffect, finds highest crossed milestone via [...MILESTONES].reverse().find(), persists per (providerKey, metric), guards against double-fire on refresh. Owner-only gating in ProviderECard.jsx line 168 (`user && user.user_id === p.user_id`) verified by negative test (client login sees no banner).
Confetti CSS animation uses css custom props (--rot-start, --rot-end) for per-piece rotation — clean, no JS animation loop, GPU-friendly.

ComunidadLayout TabBar correctly uses useSmartNav hook — verified -translate-y-full toggles on scroll down/up. transition-transform duration-300 gives smooth slide. bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80 all confirmed in DOM classList.
Three MilestoneConfetti instances (likes/reviews/bookmarks) share providerKey but with `-rev` / `-bm` suffix to keep localStorage keys distinct — correct.

MILESTONE thresholds [10,25,50,100,250,500,1000,2500,5000] are reasonable but tightly clustered at low end (10→25→50). For a small business at 11 likes that creeps to 24 over a week, they only see ONE celebration. Maybe fine for MVP.

ProviderECard sums (p.like_count || 0) + (p.likes_count || 0) — confirmed both fields exist; in test, like_count=10 + likes_count=3 = 13 ≥ 10 milestone fires. Good defensive handling of dual count fields.

rca of the issue: LeftNav non-render RCA: ComunidadLayout was added in an earlier section (39) as a persistent wrapper. To prevent ComunidadPage from rendering its OWN duplicate header/nav inside the wrapper, App.js was given `<ComunidadPage embedded />` so the page skipped its top h1 + leftnav. In Section 62, the LeftNav was updated to the new 4-item set (Feed/Explorar/Ranking/HoF) but the `embedded` flag was not revisited — so the new LeftNav is effectively dead code on the /comunidad routes. Fix path: either (a) drop `embedded` prop from the index route and let ComunidadPage render its own LeftNav (will require removing the duplicate h1 from ComunidadPage), or (b) move the LeftNav rendering into ComunidadLayout itself (alongside TabBar) and use lg:block / lg:hidden to split them by breakpoint.
